description: The Global Ionospheric Radio Observatory gathers real-time and retrospective HF ionospheric sounding data from a worldwide network of Digisonde and other ionosondes into the Lowell DIDBase. The Lowell GIRO Data Center at the University of Massachusetts Lowell, cooperating with the URSI Ionosonde Network Advisory Group, distributes more than 17 million ionograms with matching URSI-standard characteristics and electron density profiles, more than 10 million Doppler skymap records showing plasma drifts, traveling ionospheric disturbance diagnostics and software, and the IRTAM assimilative model that publishes a global map of ionospheric peak density and height every 15 minutes, with the GAMBIT database holding 15 years of these maps. Coverage is global, at the sites that contribute data. Format and access: web portal downloads and real-time feeds; use requires acknowledgement of the data providers. Licence: GIRO Rules of the Road, not read in full; free. Caveats: site coverage is uneven and some sites are only planned. It supplies the ionospheric observations behind radio, GNSS and satellite communication hazard exposure studies. Related catalogue records are the INGV ESWUA ionospheric data and the BoM World Data Centre for space weather.
